capabilities: Edit Markdown notes in a rich text sidebar view
Apply formatting with toolbar buttons and keyboard shortcuts
Insert and edit tables, links, and images
Render callouts, Mermaid diagrams, and read-only HTML blocks
Auto-save changes back to Markdown files
disambiguation: Despite the name similarity, it is not related to Obsidian's built-in editor modes; it replaces them with a vendored Wysimark rich text editor in a sidebar.
extras: Notes that table layout and list indentation may be normalized on save, and mentions vendored fixes from wysimark-lite 1.0.0; also warns that formatting shortcuts take priority over Obsidian's global commands while the editor is focused.
problem: Obsidian's default editors are source-based, so users who want a word-processor-style editing interface must leave the vault or switch editors.

relations.evidence: This plugin is built using Wysimark, an excellent open-source WYSIWYG Markdown editor.

summary: WYSIWYG Markdown editor that opens notes in a rich text sidebar while saving pure Markdown.
